name: salon-booking-bot-scripts
description: Build-time tooling (NOT runtime): compile the ajv-standalone intent validator from the committed schema, generate the web config TYPES from the committed schema, drift-check both against what is committed, and enforce the build-time server/client boundary. ORDER MATTERS IN A FRESH CLONE: `check-all` never WRITES the build artefacts, so it cannot manufacture the outputs it is checking for. (It does RUN a build — the snippet freshness check rebuilds into a temp dir — and the earlier wording here said "it never builds", which web/README.md in the same change called false.) web/site/config.generated.json and web/site/public/barber-widget.js are gitignored build artefacts, so a tree that has never been built fails this gate by design. Run the build first: `npm --prefix scripts ci && npm --prefix web ci && npm --prefix web run build -w @salon/snippet` then `npm --prefix scripts run check-all`. It is deliberately NOT chained into one script: the snippet's --check now byte-compares the bundle against a rebuild, and a gate that rebuilds immediately before comparing can never fail.
